claims.text: Ciprofloxacin (or ofloxacin) four to five drops BID for 14 days
claims.quote: Four to 5 drops of topical ciprofloxacin (or ofloxacin) solution are instilled in the affected ear 2 times a day for 14 days.
claims.locator: Treatment of Chronic Suppurative Otitis Media

claims.text: Granulation tissue: ciprofloxacin + dexamethasone for 7–14 days after removal, or 10–14 days without debridement
claims.quote: When granulation tissue is present, it may be removed with microinstruments or cauterization with silver nitrate sticks. Ciprofloxacin and dexamethasone is then instilled into the ear canal for 7 to 14 days. Alternatively, ciprofloxacin and dexamethasone can be given for 10 to 14 days without debridement.
claims.locator: Treatment of Chronic Suppurative Otitis Media

claims.text: No aminoglycoside (eg, neomycin, tobramycin) or polymyxin drops with a perforated TM or a tympanostomy tube (ototoxic)
claims.quote: Ear drops that contain aminoglycosides (eg, neomycin, tobramycin) or polymyxin should not be prescribed for patients with a perforated tympanic membrane or patients with a tympanostomy tube because of potential ototoxicity.
claims.locator: Treatment of Chronic Suppurative Otitis Media
